compiled_state.title: [merge-to-main-pr]: _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD unset -> ESCALATE blocks merge completion on every PR
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 0039fc6c01a247f4e1576dd9cf030478bd0d58e4
* **file:** plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (function _phase_resolve_threads, ~line 896)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

merge-to-main.sh completes successfully when there are no unresolved PR review threads. The thread-resolution phase should either poll and dispatch LLM agents when threads exist, or exit cleanly when there are none. The merge reaches main and the ephemeral worktree can be cleaned up.

#### Actual Behavior

The _phase_resolve_threads function checks for _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD at entry, before any threads are fetched. When unset (the default in all environments since the helper was deleted in S3), the function immediately emits:

```
ESCALATE: _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD not set; no LLM helper available (deleted in S3).
Configure _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD to a compat-shim or override per-environment to
enable PR thread resolution. Refusing to silently skip.
```

and returns 1, causing merge-to-main.sh to exit 1. This blocks every PR-mode merge in every worktree session regardless of whether any review threads exist.

### 3. Action History

1. Sprint epic dbbc-cf67-8cfc-4b4d completed (14 commits, completion verifier PASS).
2. /dso:end-session Step 11 ran `.claude/scripts/dso merge-to-main.sh`.
3. Script pushed branch, created PR #71, queued GitHub auto-merge successfully.
4. Script entered _phase_resolve_threads, hit the _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD guard, and exited 1 with ESCALATE.
5. merge-to-main.sh exited 1 before completing its state machine.

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

The LLM helper that previously satisfied _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD was removed during S3 refactors. A compat-shim was noted as needed (bug 9e04-0eb6) but never implemented. The guard was added intentionally to fail-loud rather than silently skip thread resolution (bug 9e04-0eb6 context). The result is that every merge is permanently blocked until the shim exists.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **merge-to-main-pr.sh**: _phase_resolve_threads (~line 877): function requires _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD to be set before entering the thread-resolution loop. Guard fires before any `gh` call to check for actual unresolved threads.
* **COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md / end-session SKILL.md Step 11**: merge-to-main.sh is the required merge path for PR-mode merges; manual merge is explicitly prohibited.

### 6. Logs

```
INFO: Created PR #71: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/71
INFO: Auto-merge queued for PR #71.
ESCALATE: _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD not set; no LLM helper available (deleted in S3).
Configure _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD to a compat-shim or override per-environment to
enable PR thread resolution. Refusing to silently skip.
Exit code: 1
```

comments.body: debug-everything 2026-05-08: Classification: behavioral (code defect in merge-to-main-pr.sh). Fix applied: deferred the _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD empty-check from function entry (line 904, original) to just before the dispatch call (line ~1010), so PRs with zero unresolved threads settle cleanly via _pr_settling_check without ever requiring the helper. Fail-loud safety property of bug 9e04-0eb6 preserved when dispatch is actually needed (threads present + LLM unset).
